# Verification pass for prime subscription
from datetime import datetime

amazon_token = globals().get('amazon_token')
if not amazon_token:
    login_res = apis.amazon.login(username='matthew.blac@gmail.com', password='Kv8O=+h')
    amazon_token = login_res['access_token']

acct = apis.amazon.show_account(access_token=amazon_token)
print('amazon_account_is_prime', acct.get('is_prime'), 'verified', acct.get('verified'), 'email', acct.get('email'))

# Show all prime subscriptions (paginate)
subs = []
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.amazon.show_prime_subscriptions(access_token=amazon_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    print('subs page', i, 'size', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    subs.extend(page)
    i += 1
print('total_prime_subscriptions', len(subs))
# Print last few for inspection
for s in sorted(subs, key=lambda x: x.get('start_date',''), reverse=True)[:5]:
    print('sub', s)
